scientific_integrity: Explicit algebraic all-dimension proof supplemented by exact-rational reproducibility checks. Literature comparisons are bounded; no independence or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Normalized unit-root union only; exact degree six only; uniqueness only for antipodally symmetric weights. Invariant weight ratio and positive-weight threshold follow prior invariant-harmonic literature. Unsearched older association-scheme tables could contain the full rank; independent validation not performed.
title: Exact sixth-harmonic sampling rank and weight rigidity of normalized type-B root systems
